_comment: EXAMPLE (not the live path): AZURE OPENAI inference provider target. Use this when one end of your migration is a model deployed in Azure OpenAI. Azure differs from OpenAI first-party in three ways reflected below: (1) the endpoint is your resource's host, https://<your-resource>.openai.azure.com; (2) the model id is your Azure DEPLOYMENT NAME, not the base model name; (3) auth is an 'api-key' header, NOT 'Authorization: Bearer'. Azure also requires an api-version; set it on the operation path or via your deployment's default. The key goes in an AgentCore API_KEY credential provider (setup_gateway.py reads AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY). To use: set SOURCE_MODEL = mc.EXAMPLE_SOURCE_AZURE_OPENAI, edit the endpoint + deployment name + api-version below, and provision this target.
name: azure
